per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The user interface must be easy to use and learn such that occasional users can complete a room reservation without training.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use. 90% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Basic user interactions (e.g., reserving a room, checking availability) must appear instantaneous to the user; most quick tasks should complete in under 10 seconds and very basic tasks under 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Search results and availability information must be accurate and reliable to prevent double-booking and conflicts.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall allow for intuitive searching of available conference rooms.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must provide clear, unambiguous confirmations and feedback so users are confident a booking has succeeded and know next steps.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must reliably send invites and reminders to internal and external email systems and ensure messages are well-formed and delivered (minimizing bounces or malformed content).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must interoperate correctly with the organization's varied internal mail servers and external clients so invites and reminders leave the system and are delivered properly.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must maintain very high availability; target uptime should be approximately 99.9% or higher (near continuous availability) to avoid disrupting meetings.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Error messages must be actionable and user-friendly: they should explain what went wrong and provide clear next steps or alternatives without forcing users off the current page.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must support accessibility features in accordance with ADA/WCAG standards, including screen-reader compatibility, keyboard-only navigation, high-contrast themes, and visible focus indicators.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The interface must support multiple languages and locale-specific date/time formats so that at least ~90% of users in each country perceive formatting as correct.

per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall be able to display calendar dates and times according to the user's locale. 90% of survey respondents from each target market country will find that the date and time formatting of the product is correct.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must display times and time zones clearly for cross-time-zone meetings (e.g., show both organizer and local participant times) to avoid joining at incorrect times.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall be able to display calendar dates and times according to the user's locale. 90% of survey respondents from each target market country will find that the date and time formatting of the product is correct.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must prevent or properly handle concurrent booking conflicts so that multiple users are not all confirmed for the same slot.
